proposed.text: A firm agrees an MDPE multiplier of 2.0 (within the SPP 202 Sec 5.2 range of 1.5-2.5) on a direct personnel cost of PHP 900,000. What is the Fee before reimbursables?
proposed.rationale: SPP 202 Sec 5.2 gives the total multiplier range of 1.5-2.5 and does NOT decompose it into 1.55 overhead + 0.30 profit + 0.15 non-technical; that decomposition is an exam trap the article body rejects. Fee = DPE x M = PHP 900,000 x 2.0 = PHP 1,800,000 before reimbursables. Source: SPP 202 Sec 5.2 (https://www.architectureboard.com.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/1.4-2010-SPP-for-PH-Architects.pdf).
proposed.explanation: Fee = DPE x M with a source-backed M within 1.5-2.5. The 1.55+0.30+0.15 decomposition is not source-backed.
